key_expressions: I'm getting used to dorm life,
Are the dorm rules okay for you?,
How’s the atmosphere in your room?,

A: I think I’m finally getting used to living in the dorm.
I get along with my roommate better than I expected.
There are still a lot of rules, so it feels a bit strict sometimes.
B: Oh, that’s great! Adjusting early makes everything easier.
Finding a good roommate is seriously lucky.
You’ll get used to the rules before you know it.

A: I really like how quiet my dorm room is.
It actually helps me study much better.
As long as I follow the curfew, everything is fine at night.
B: Wow, a quiet room is perfect for studying!
I’m glad you can focus well—that’s a big plus.
The curfew won’t bother you much once you get used to it.

A: I checked out the dorm lounge yesterday and it felt pretty nice.
People were chatting comfortably, which I liked.
I think I’ll go there more often from now on.
B: Yeah, that lounge has a surprisingly good vibe!
It’s also a great spot to get to know people naturally.
Let’s go together sometime if you’d like.

A: I couldn’t sleep well during my first week in the dorm, but now I’m fine.
I guess it was just the new environment.
These days I feel relaxed and fall asleep pretty fast.
B: That happens to everyone at first. Everything feels unfamiliar.
But you adapted really quickly—impressive!
Once it feels comfortable, dorm life gets so much easier.

A: The food in the dorm cafeteria is better than I expected.
There are lots of options, so I don’t get tired of it.
I even started eating breakfast regularly.
B: Really? Sounds like the menu got better lately!
Having variety definitely makes meals more fun.
Eating breakfast is such a good habit—nice job.

A: I still get a little confused when using the laundry room.
The payment system is more complicated than I thought.
But I think I’ll get used to it if I keep using it.
B: Oh, I was super confused at first too!
Yeah, the payment system is unnecessarily complicated.
If you want, I can show you how it works later.

A: Everyone in the dorm is pretty quiet, which makes the atmosphere nice.
It’s not noisy at night, so it’s comfortable.
I feel like I’m less stressed because of that.
B: That kind of atmosphere is amazing—really good for living!
Noise at night can ruin everything, so that’s lucky.
Having less stress is honestly the biggest benefit.

A: I haven’t really used the shared kitchen yet.
I get a bit hesitant because I think there might be too many people.
But I do want to try using it someday.
B: The shared kitchen is actually pretty nice!
If you go when it’s not crowded, it’s super comfortable to use.
Once you try it the first time, you’ll get used to it quickly.

A: The dorm Wi-Fi feels slow these days.
It almost doesn’t work in the evenings.
It gets a bit inconvenient when I’m doing assignments.
B: Same here! Evenings are the worst—so frustrating.
I think everyone connects at the same time.
If you need, using your phone’s hotspot might help temporarily.

A: I’m realizing that living in the dorm is more fun than I expected.
It’s nice getting closer to people naturally.
I think this year is going to be pretty enjoyable.
B: That’s awesome to hear!
Making friends in the dorm gives you so many good memories.
I’m sure you’ll have lots of great moments ahead!
